the town's Environmental Awareness Month is off to a great
start. ® This program aims to educate the public about local
environmental issues, especially protecting Hadmonton
Beach. This past week, ®the organizing committee has
been giving away free beach towels made from 100 percent
recycled materials. Olf you'd like one, these great products
are available at special kiosks along Hadmonton Beach. But
there aren't many towels left! ® And now, on the line is Greg
Wilson from the mayor's office to give us more information.
